The '''R-9X heavy laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] manufactured by [[Gyrhil/Legends|Gyrhil]]. [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil's]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]<ref name="EGVV" /> and the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate's]] [[Hornet-class interceptor|''Hornet''-class interceptors]] incorporated R-9X heavy laser cannons as part of their weapons systems. With modifications, the R-9X heavy laser cannon could be upgraded, overcharging them to deal twice the amount of damage. However, this came at the cost of them momentarily overheating. R-9X's installed on ''Hornet''-class interceptors were upgraded in that manner.<ref name="FF117">{{FactFile|117|HOR 1-2|Hornet Interceptor}}</ref>
